task_title: Implement Queen Mab Verdigris Glamour arena slice

plan_review.notes: Adversarial reviewer enumerated 3 alternatives to the chosen design (integer frame-deadline scheduler vs float timer+epsilon; immutable MobAbilityCast event record vs mutable instance state; single typed adapter vs a discriminated-union ability-kind registry) and argued against the float-timer + single-adapter choice. 6 concerns: (1) float timer accumulation — ACCEPTED: dt is exactly GAME.DELTA_MS, all catalog durations are integer multiples of it, and a 1e-6 epsilon absorbs residual; frame indices 540/630/1170/1260 verified exact. (2) global encounter reset semantics — ACCEPTED for the single-boss arena; documented as a future multi-encounter extension point. (3) circle-only geometry + player-only targeting — ACCEPTED as the incremental typed-adapter path; new ability kinds add adapters, not a DSL. (4) re-register overwrite of a live instance — FIXED: registerMobAbility now clears prior cue + owned effects first. (5) invalid/dead locked target at telegraph time — FIXED downstream in code review: findDefaultTarget skips dead/absent players so beginTelegraph re-arms with no phantom cast. (6) renderer reads cached geometry — ACCEPTED: renderer is presentation-only and consumes the committed public cue state, never simulation state. Divergence 'minor': the chosen catalog-driven typed-adapter + fixed-step design held; changes were hardening, not a re-architecture.

escalated_to_human.reason: Round 2 resolved one of its two valid concerns, but the remaining valid concern still left the stage non-clean. Under the 2-round cap, the required bounded-review outcome was human escalation rather than the previously recorded third confirmation round.
